blocks.content:
Congratulations on completing this journey! Job well done!

We hope you've enjoyed traveling with us as you:

- Learned when querying Elasticsearch directly is the right choice
- Verified your Elasticsearch instance is running and gathered connection details
- Added the Elasticsearch data source in Grafana Cloud
- Configured the URL, authentication, index name, and time field
- Successfully tested the connection to your Elasticsearch instance
- Queried and explored Elasticsearch data in Grafana Explore
